integrity: The proof reduces every possible collision to one of 18 bounded Parikh-difference directions forced by 2-balance. Sufficiency follows by classifying their weighted kernels; necessity is witnessed by explicit Tribonacci factors for each midpoint relation and one-letter factors for repeated weights. A standalone verifier replays the finite algebra and witness checks.
scientific_limitations: The classification is specific to the ordinary Tribonacci word and integer valuations. It uses the published 2-balance theorem and does not classify all ternary balanced words or additive-power behavior.
title: Exact valuations preserving Tribonacci abelian complexity
